proposal.blind_spot: The metrics show DRAM is busy but cannot distinguish a truly bandwidth-saturated kernel with abundant grid/occupancy parallelism from a latency-bound one with too few warps in flight, so the optimizer cannot choose between preserving the launch shape and cutting bytes versus adding occupancy and memory-level parallelism.

rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: HIGH -> grid already over-subscribes the SMs; do not collapse the grid or serialize per-block work, only reduce DRAM bytes (fuse passes, avoid intermediates) / LOW -> grid too small to saturate DRAM; split work into more blocks or smaller tiles to increase memory-level parallelism
rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy is fine and warps merely wait on saturated DRAM; only traffic reduction helps, avoid register/instruction-heavy rewrites / LOW -> latency-bound from insufficient resident warps; cut registers or shared memory per block and unroll/vectorize loads to raise occupancy and outstanding loads
